delegates.label: EIP-7702 forwarder sweeper (Base)
delegates.note: Identified from live bytecode on 2026-11-03 by SweepCheck's own check of a victim wallet; forwards to 0x70a3df699512f39c682f94fad498454c90b8c219. Re-checked 2026-11-15: contract code still present on Base via eth_getCode, forwarder fingerprint selectors 0xc4d66de8 and 0xb269681d both present in the bytecode.

delegates.label: Generic executor used by key-testing bots (Base)
delegates.note: RPC check 2026-11-15: no delegation code observed — eth_getCode returns 3,335 bytes of ordinary contract bytecode (a deployed contract, not an 0xef0100 delegation) and neither forwarder fingerprint selector (0xc4d66de8 / 0xb269681d) is present, so sweeper behavior remains unconfirmed. Kept conservative rather than raised to checked-live.
